alt:
It's You - Gator Days

Characters

???? - Squirrel - OH! It's- Uh... What's her name. She works for the same company as August but in a different building now. Dang, her name is on the tip of my tongue.

August - Alligator - A soft spoken single father who works in IT. Gustopher's dad.

Transcript

Panel 1

August is at work and a fresh cup of coffee in his mug that says "BYTE CLUB". On the mug are four dots above "BYTE" and four dots below "CLUB". He likes this mug. Someone is approaching him from behind and loudly announces her presence.

????: AUGUST! I thought that was you.

Panel 2

Oh look! It's... Some random person who August works with. You know, good ol'... Susan? No, that can't be right. Anyway, she is excited to see August.

????: I haven't seen you since I was moved to the new office. Hope you and your kid are well.

Panel 3

Oh no, looks like mystery lady has to go.

????: GOTTA RUN! Great to see you. Bye!

Panel 4

August just stares forward and is unsure on what to say or do.

August (thinking): I have no idea who that was.
